title: Common subsequence of length k

problem.name: Common subsequence of length k
problem.statement_latex: Given two strings of length at most $n$ and a fixed positive integer $k$, decide whether they have a common subsequence of length at least $k$, and output one if it exists. Complexity counts character queries.
problem.statement_text: Given two strings of length at most $n$ and a fixed positive integer $k$, decide whether they have a common subsequence of length at least $k$, and output one if it exists. Complexity counts character queries.
